The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `9200` (see `ElasticsearchBuilder.ElasticsearchHttpsPort`)
- Port: `9300` (see `ElasticsearchBuilder.ElasticsearchTcpPort`)
- Environment variable: `ELASTIC_PASSWORD=elastic` (see `ElasticsearchBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Environment variable: `discovery.type=single-node`
- Environment variable: `ingest.geoip.downloader.enabled=false`
- File: `/usr/share/elasticsearch/config/jvm.options.d/elasticsearch-default-memory-vm.options`

    ```
    -Xms2147483648
    -Xmx2147483648
    ```

- Wait strategy: Waits until the cluster health status is green or yellow, and the OTLP index templates are installed if OTLP is enabled.
